title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Tom Kim Shares Scottish Open Lead
items.text: Tom Kim, Bernd Wiesberger, Patrick Cantlay, Rory McIlroy, and Rasmus Højgaard are tied for the lead at -5 after the first round of the Genesis Scottish Open at the Renaissance Club.

items.headline: PGA Tour Embraces Meritocracy
items.text: Xander Schauffele praised the PGA Tour's new schedule where players must perform well to earn money, describing it as a 'you eat what you kill' meritocracy with cuts in every event enhancing competitive pressure.
